hero.title: ArcGIS Enterprise
hero.subtitle: Power your location intelligence. Deploy in your infrastructure and keep full control over security, reliability, and scalability.

intro.paragraph: Build your foundation with the platform that started it all—ArcGIS Enterprise—the complete system for all your geospatial needs. Get the tools to make maps, analyze data, solve problems, and share geospatial data. Behind your firewall or in the cloud, our market-leading Enterprise GIS mapping software will support your work and deliver results.

software.heading: Map and analyze with the leading GIS software
software.subheading: Build your solutions with ArcGIS Enterprise.
software.imageAlt: People using ArcGIS in a hex scene

items.title: Secure enterprise deployment
items.desc: With automation tools to get up and running quickly, ArcGIS Enterprise can be deployed on-premises or in the cloud. Choose to customize as much as you want by adding ready-to-go capabilities and applications.

items.title: Data management
items.desc: Connect to your own existing data stores and ready-to-use storage. Take advantage of Esri’s extensive collection of curated geospatial data for enhanced perspective.

items.title: Mapping & visualization
items.desc: Visualize your data spatially and start connecting the dots to improve your business decisions. From a simple web map to a fully customized application, you can choose the way you want your data to be displayed for maximum impact.

items.title: Analysis & discovery
items.desc: Perform analysis in your web browser with ArcGIS Enterprise tools that help you see patterns, trends, and anomalies in your data. Uncover the power of your data—whether it’s raster, big data, or real-time—with ArcGIS Enterprise.

rows.title: Access
rows.desc: Data-driven decision-making starts with a secure, browser-based enterprise platform that lets you control, store, and access data.

rows.title: Analyze
rows.desc: Unlock location intelligence when you look at data through a spatial lens. Perform analysis that lets you see and understand data in a deeper way.

rows.title: Share
rows.desc: Get data into the hands of those who need it, when they need it. Share info within your organization and beyond so you can make data-driven decisions.

foundation.heading: Build your foundation with ArcGIS Enterprise
foundation.blurb: Get started with ArcGIS Enterprise, the industry-leading geospatial platform. Boost your spatial prowess with Esri’s extensive collection of apps and add-on capabilities.

tiles.title: ArcGIS Pro
tiles.desc: ArcGIS Enterprise powers the dynamic next-generation desktop GIS technology that gives you everything you need to create and share 2D and 3D maps.

tiles.title: ArcGIS Online
tiles.desc: ArcGIS Enterprise seamlessly collaborates with this software-as-a-service app, giving you the same powerful mapping tools in the cloud for your convenience.

tiles.title: Apps for everyone
tiles.desc: Extend the power of ArcGIS Enterprise with apps that enhance your workflow from the office to the field.

tiles.title: Make your own apps
tiles.desc: Don’t see what you need? Use our APIs and SDKs to build your own GIS applications for desktop, web, and mobile.
